statement: Serve authorized run state and exact current correspondence for one configured Vibez checkout.
acceptanceCriteria: MR-002.1: In a clean installed consumer, inspect a real CLI-started run over HTTP and return the exact current role or repair correspondence bytes. Repeated status/list/copy observations leave native gates and handoffs untouched.

MR-002.2: Enforce loopback listener, exact Host and browser origin, expiring operator pairing, scoped project/profile/session and bound packet identity, request/response limits and safe artifact resolution.
MR-002.3: Distinguish missing, offline, unsupported, prepared and blocked states. Advertise only enabled read capabilities and expose known gate, revision and PR/CI provenance without guessing.
